referenceFunction.generalComment: The two types of storage hydropower stations (pure storage and pump storage) are combined in the dataset as it is difficult to separate the different types. Various types of dams higher than 30 meters are taken into account. The lifetime is assumed to be 150 years for the dams and 80 years for the rest of the materials. The data set describes a mix and is therefore not representative for individual plants. This dataset recalculated based on Frischknecht et al. (1996) and Bauer (2007), complemented with data from Vattenfall (2008).; UUID: 192969a9-5bfc-355d-8620-a2bc4a884c10
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset includes the most important materials used for the construction of an average hydropower reservoir in the alpine regions of Europe and its disposal/recycling. Furthermore, transports and energy used for the construction as well as particle emissions due to the construction activities are included.
referenceFunction.name: Reservoir hydropower plant, alpine region

technology.text: Mix of reservoir hydropower plants built between 1945 and 1970, therefore the data is not representative for more modern or individual reservoir hydropower stations. Capacity: 95MW
